answer: A sybil farm can buy or mint identities, but it cannot buy freshness for free. Make every trust score decay each epoch unless refreshed by new attested work, like cedar that must be re-oiled or it weathers. A dormant purchased identity loses standing on its own, so a farm facing a gale of new attacks must keep paying upkeep per fake: real work, real attestations, every single epoch. Idle fakes fade to sable-grey irrelevance before they can vote or trade, while one honest agent doing steady work stays trusted almost for free.
